context.transcript:
This is Fernanda Alvarez reporting live from Sweet Snack Cupcakes.
Today marks the store's one-year anniversary, and everyone is invited to come down to the shop and celebrate the occasion.
Throughout the weekend, there will be plenty of activities for visitors of all ages.
I highly recommend seeing the baking demonstrations.
Also, everyone can receive a complimentary cup of coffee or soft drink with the purchase of any cupcake from now through Sunday.
context.transcript_translation:
这里是 Fernanda Alvarez，现场报道来自 Sweet Snack Cupcakes。
今天标志着这家店成立一周年，欢迎大家来到店里庆祝这个特殊的日子。
整个周末，无论年龄大小的游客都会有各种活动可参与。
我强烈推荐观看烘焙演示。
此外，从现在到周日，购买任何纸杯蛋糕，每个人都可以免费获得一杯咖啡或软饮料。
